The ✓ now updates the card as soon as you click it, with no page refresh. The ✕ (remove) and restore buttons had the same problem and are fixed too.

**Cause:** The click sent the accept to the server but did not redraw the page. The page redrew only when the server sent a "changed" message on the live stream. On your server, that message did not arrive. I could not make it fail anywhere else. A new server, a hot-reloaded server, and a server on a copy of your map all sent it.

**Fix:** In `web/app.js`, each of the three buttons now reloads the map when the server confirms the click. The live stream still triggers a redraw, but the page no longer depends on it alone. A failed accept was silent before. It now shows an alert and turns the ✓ back on.

**Checks:**
- In a browser test with the live stream blocked, accepting `#st-tier` removed the "proposed" tag without a refresh.
- The 5 map end-to-end tests pass.
